title: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: The general of Drannith who leads the survivors along the terror road, deliberately leading them into Vadrok's nest as bait.

entities.name: Colonel Bryd
entities.description: A Coppercoat colonel who distrusts Vivien and urges Jirina to send soldiers ahead.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker and hunter with an arkbow who helps defend the Drannith survivors and kills Lukka.

entities.name: Chevill
entities.description: Ikoria's most accomplished monster hunter, a boastful exterminator who helps ambush Lukka.

entities.name: Phyrexian Lukka
entities.description: A compleated version of Lukka riding at the heart of a titan of stolen flesh, who returns to Ikoria to conquer Drannith's survivors.

entities.name: Haldan
entities.description: A bonder with a stone club who protects Jirina and later accuses her of using the people as bait.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: A catlike dragon, the apex monster of Raugrin, who attacks the Phyrexian titan and tears Lukka out of it.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane of monsters now under invasion.

entities.name: Raugrin
entities.description: A volcanic region of Ikoria scoured by fire and quakes.

entities.name: Jal Korcha
entities.description: The terror road through Raugrin along which Drannith's survivors flee.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A human city of Ikoria that has fallen to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Lavabrink
entities.description: A walled city with lava on its outer walls that is the survivors' destination.

entities.name: Savai
entities.description: A plain of Ikoria that was home to great cats.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane from which the strike team came and Lukka was transformed.

entities.name: The arkbow
entities.description: Vivien's bow containing spirits of beasts that form spectral arrows.

entities.name: The Coppercoats
entities.description: The soldiers of Drannith.

entities.name: The Specials
entities.description: A group whose captain was once Lukka.

entities.name: Chevill's hunters
entities.description: Black-clad exterminators who ambush the Lukka titan.

entities.name: The bonders
entities.description: People of Ikoria bonded with monsters.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde invading Ikoria.

entities.name: The eludha
entities.description: Lukka's monster bonding, twisted by Phyrexia.

events.summary: Jirina leads Drannith's survivors along the terror road toward Lavabrink while Colonel Bryd urges sending soldiers ahead.
events.quote: Perhaps it would be wise to send a detachment of soldiers ahead, to prepare Lavabrink for our arrival.

events.summary: Bryd questions trusting Vivien, and Jirina rejects his suspicion; then an attack on the column begins.
events.quote: I won't have you discarding one of our strongest on baseless paranoia!

events.summary: Vivien and Chevill's hunters prepare an ambush with buried explosives in a canyon, expecting Lukka.
events.quote: she and Chevill were the only thing standing between those people and their doom.

events.summary: A vantasaur flees the canyon, is dragged back and consumed by something unseen.
events.quote: before all thirty tons were dragged violently backward out of sight

events.summary: Phyrexian Lukka emerges from the canyon, a titan of absorbed flesh with Lukka embedded at its center.
events.quote: At its center protruded—not a man, anymore, not quite, but Lukka.

events.summary: Vivien recalls she persuaded Lukka to go to New Phyrexia and that the titan absorbs creatures through his twisted eludha.
events.quote: it was Vivien who had convinced him to go to New Phyrexia with the strike team.

events.summary: The titan triggers buried mines and plunges its leg into lava, and Chevill's hunters attack with poisoned arrows and spears.
events.quote: They loosed a stinging cloud of arrows, peppering the Lukka-thing's flank

events.summary: Vivien's first arrow is blocked by bone, and the titan tears free of the hunters' ropes and kills many of them.
events.quote: with a sweep of one misshapen arm, the giant cleared them from the scrubland

events.summary: Vivien summons a spectral dreadmaw through her arkbow, but the titan destroys it and escapes the lava.
events.quote: The dreadmaw simply dissolved

events.summary: Chevill refuses to follow, saying they have lost, but Vivien holds him back and fires an arrow into the sky as a signal of failure.
events.quote: before twisting her body and shooting it straight into the sky

events.summary: Phyrexian cats attack Jirina's Coppercoats and Jirina kills one with her sword.
events.quote: almost severing the head entirely

events.summary: A tigorilla and Haldan save Jirina from a second cat, and the tigorilla's crystals burn off Phyrexian oil.
events.quote: the Phyrexian oil bubbled and hissed, turning to a sickly black smoke

events.summary: Jirina sees Vivien's green signals and knows the ambush failed and Lukka is still coming.
events.quote: That was the signal. They had failed. Lukka was still coming.

events.summary: Jirina deliberately changes the column's course to a path that does not lead to Lavabrink, silencing Haldan's warning about whose territory it is.
events.quote: If you want to make it to nightfall alive, you'll say nothing.

events.summary: The refugees enter a basin of volcanic glass with no exit, realizing they are not at Lavabrink.
events.quote: there seemed to be no other road or pass out.

events.summary: Phyrexian Lukka climbs into the basin and announces in a thousand voices that Drannith's prodigal son has returned to offer Phyrexian unity.
events.quote: DRANNITH! TRAITOR-CITY! YOUR PRODIGAL SON HAS RETURNED FOR YOU.

events.summary: Vivien climbs a cliff and sees Vadrok swoop down to attack the titan, revealing the basin as Vadrok's nest.
events.quote: We're in its nest.

events.summary: Vadrok burns away much of the titan with blue flame and pulls Lukka out of it.
events.quote: Struggling now in Vadrok's jaws was Lukka .

events.summary: Vivien shoots Lukka in the chest with several arrows as he hangs in Vadrok's jaws, killing him.
events.quote: She pulled back one more spectral arrow and put it in the center of his chest.

events.summary: Jirina watches Vadrok toss Lukka's corpse aside and burn what remains of the titan.
events.quote: So passes the captain of the Specials

events.summary: Vivien steps in front of the survivors to keep Vadrok from attacking them, and Vadrok flies away.
events.quote: Then it was aloft again

events.summary: Haldan and the crowd accuse Jirina of using them as bait, and Jirina defends that she had no other way.
events.quote: In war, there are no certainties,

events.summary: Vivien tells the survivors to survive what is coming, as another Phyrexian branch descends behind the mountains.
events.quote: A branch, Vivien had called them

relations.quote: She pulled back one more spectral arrow and put it in the center of his chest.

relations.note: attacks the titan in its nest and tears Lukka out
relations.quote: It dove toward the greatest threat laid out across the basin

relations.note: Jirina trusts Vivien as one of her strongest allies
relations.quote: We have few enough allies as it is.
leaving her alone with the man they called their leader
One of the bonders, she remembered now.
